fields.name: pt_feasible
fields.computation: 1.0 = a feasible itinerary exists in the departure window under the routing rules; 0.0 otherwise

fields.name: pt_access_time_min
fields.computation: network walk time origin -> first boarding stop (access radius 700 m)

fields.name: pt_egress_time_min
fields.computation: network walk time last alighting stop -> destination (egress radius 700 m, extended 1.5 km allowed)

fields.name: pt_wait_time_min
fields.computation: first boarding departure - trip departure - access walk

fields.name: pt_in_vehicle_time_min
fields.computation: total time aboard transit vehicles (direct or 1-transfer itinerary)

fields.name: pt_transfer_count
fields.computation: vehicle-to-vehicle transfer count of the itinerary

fields.name: pt_transfer_time_min
fields.computation: alight vehicle -> board next (walk + wait at transfer; connection window 180-2700 s)

fields.name: pt_total_door_to_door_time_min
fields.computation: T_PT = T_access + T_wait + T_invehicle + T_transfer + T_egress (infeasible sentinel = 120 min)

fields.name: pt_coverage_ratio
fields.computation: R_coverage = D_PT,vehicle / D_OD (straight-line in-vehicle distance / OD distance), clipped [0,1]

fields.name: pt_generalized_cost
fields.computation: NOT DEFINED — S8 §7.10: no invented value-of-time parameters; raw features only

infeasible_convention: pt stays in the choice set with pt_feasible=0 and sentinel travel_time 120 min (FVR is learned behavior, not a mask)
identity: ALL fields are city-independent numeric attributes; no stop_id/route_id/node id/place name ever enters the student/teacher input
